introduction: CAPK VITA offers free tax preparation and e-filing for eligible low- and moderate-income taxpayers. Ask whether your return is within the service’s scope.
description: CAPK VITA offers free tax preparation and e-filing for eligible low- and moderate-income taxpayers. Ask whether your return is within the service’s scope.

sections.who: Income and return complexity affect service availability. CAPK also lists ITIN application assistance and help with tax-agency letters.
sections.get: Staff and volunteers prepare eligible returns and assess applicable credits. A refund is not guaranteed.
sections.docs:
• Photo ID and SSN or ITIN documentation for everyone on the return.
  • W-2s, 1099s and other income records.
  • Applicable education, health-insurance and child-care documents.
  • Bank details if requesting direct deposit.
sections.apply:
1. Book intake

    Call 661-834-1724 or211 using CAPK VITA.

  2. Confirm scope

    Ask about the tax year, return type and documents.

  3. Review before filing

    Check the completed return and retain copies.
sections.after: Track the filing confirmation and respond to tax-agency notices. Confirm appointment availability even outside filing season.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using CAPK VITA. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
